Package dayplanner

Class DayPlanner

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.DayPlanner
public class DayPlanner extends Object
DayPlanner is a simple activity management application that allows users to add and search for Home, School, and Other activities. Activities are stored in one ArrayList and can be searched using keywords and time ranges. Title keywords are kept in a HashMap from a lowercase word to the activity positions that contain it. The map is built while the file loads and updated when an activity is added. The application uses a text-based menu system and stores all dates and times using a 24-hour clock.
Version:
2.0
Author:
Jasper Bungay

    • addActivity

      public static void addActivity(int activityType)
      Prompts the user for activity information and adds a new activity to the activity list. The title index is updated in this method.
      Parameters:
      activityType - 1 = HomeActivity 2 = SchoolActivity 3 = OtherActivity

    • parseTime

      public static Time parseTime(String input)
      Converts a string in the format YYYY/MM/DD, HH:MM into a Time object.
      Parameters:
      input - Time string entered by the user.
      Returns:
      A valid Time object or null if the format or values are invalid.

    • searchActivity

      public static void searchActivity(int activityType)
      Searches activities matching the specified activity type, keywords, and time range. When keywords are entered, each word is looked up in the title index and those position lists are intersected. Type and time are checked only on that smaller set. With no keywords, the whole activity list is checked in order.
      Parameters:
      activityType - 1 = HomeActivity 2 = SchoolActivity 3 = OtherActivity 4 = Search all activities

    • keyWordsMatch

      Determines whether a title contains the specified search keywords.

      keyWords - User search keywords.
      Returns:
      true if all search keywords are present in the title, false otherwise.

    • loadActivities

      public static void loadActivities(String filename)
      Loads activities from a text file. Each activity is a block of key = "value" lines, separated from the next activity by a blank line. An invalid record is skipped so the rest of the file can still be read.
      Parameters:
      filename - File to read.

    • saveActivities

      public static void saveActivities(String filename)
      Saves every activity to a text file. Home and school activities use type, title, start, end, and comment. Other activities also include location.
      Parameters:
      filename - File to write.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Loads the activity file, then runs the menu until the user quits. The file name is the first program argument. When it is omitted, activities.txt is used.
      Parameters:
      args - command line arguments; args[0] is the data file
